visual.title: Inside first, outside second
visual.caption: The grid shows the cells the sum counts. In the inner integral the outer variable is a constant, so the inner sum only moves along one row of cells.

predict.question: In ∫₀²∫₀¹ x dy dx, which variable is constant during the inner integral?
predict.explain: The inner integral is with respect to y, so x is held constant and ∫₀¹ x dy = x.
